verdict: Holistic classification is a good place to start. On 20 packets, Claude Sonnet 5.5 got 91% of sections exactly right holistically, against 76% page by page, for $201 of classification per 1,000 packets. Claude Haiku 5.5 reading text only got 88% on 98 packets for $2.58 ([SC-02](#do-i-need-page-images-in-the-classification-prompt)). [Which way of splitting and classifying should I use?](#which-way-of-splitting-and-classifying-should-i-use) compares the approaches on 100 packets. Test it on your own packets.
